checked_sources: R. Forman, Morse theory for cell complexes, Adv. Math. 134 (1998)
correctness.rationale: Verified the exact closed-neighborhood/complimentary-domination face definition on all 65536 masks in an independently written and compiled C++17 program. Reconstructed the entire nonempty face poset (45706 faces), every one of 329552 cover incidences, the 22847 disjoint greedy pivot matching pairs and the 12 critical cells {0:1,7:10,9:1}. A fresh Kahn sort visits all 45706 faces after reversing precisely the matched incidences, proving acyclicity. The independently implemented reverse pivot order also gives the same critical cells and complete acyclicity. The facet vector {7:10,10:80,11:40} and reduced Euler characteristic -11 agree. Lower-dimensional checks give (d=1) {0:2}, (d=2) {0:1,1:3}, (d=3) {0:1,3:7}. Forman discrete Morse theory then supplies one 0-cell, ten 7-cells and one 9-cell: every cellular differential is zero due to absence of adjacent-dimensional cells, proving torsion-free integral H7=Z^10,H9=Z and six-connectivity. No assertion about the nontriviality of the 9-cell attaching map or all hypercubes is made. The initially mistyped Euler-sign comparison in the auditor’s checker was corrected by direct complement parity; only the corrected complete check is cited.
residual_risks: No complete unstable homotopy type is established: the 9-cell may attach nontrivially in pi8(wedge^10 S7).
This is a fully finite Q4 calculation, not a theorem about higher-dimensional hypercubes.
The independent check is programmatic rather than formal Lean or external expert attestation.
